Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the walk-through yesterday. Unfortunately we've hit a hard stop on our side — after the deployment to our staging IdP the connector is failing during token refresh. Our frontend can't complete OAuth exchange, and the error consistently reproduces in our staging environment.

This is blocking our demo next week and the engineering team now estimates at least ~5 business days to investigate and patch because the IdP changed their refresh contract unexpectedly. Given the delay, can Redwood extend our pilot window by 21 days and provide a small promotional credit so we can continue evaluation without burning our remaining sandbox hours?

Attaching a short dump (sso-debug.zip) and the failing stacktrace. Happy to jump on a quick call with Dev if that helps.

Best,
Alex

Hannah / Marissa —

I pulled the debug bundle Alex attached. Quick notes:
- The failure is happening in our adapter when validating the refresh token response; the IdP recently started returning an "ext_expires_in" field we don't parse and a malformed token envelope in some cases.
- Repro steps included in stacktrace.log. With a proper test client + token sample we can reproduce locally in ~2 hours and then push a fix to staging.
- Full patch + QA and smoke test will be ~3 business days; add another 1–2 business days if we need to coordinate with Cradle's IdP team for credentials.

Immediate ask to Cradle: a staging client_id + a service account token dump (short-lived credentials are fine). If Alex can provide those, we'll start tonight.

Also attaching the minimal test harness and a short output file (idp-error-dump.txt) I generated from your bundle.

—Dev

Alex —

Thanks — Dev confirms he can reproduce with a test client and will start a patch as soon as you drop the service account token. To keep your team moving we’re prepared to do the following as a one-time courtesy:

- Extend the pilot window by 30 calendar days from your current end date.
- Apply a $2,000 promotional credit against your account (to offset engineering hours burned on your side).

Conditions:
- We’ll apply the extension and credit once we receive confirmation you’ll provide the requested staging credentials and grant us temporary access for triage.
- The credit is promotional and non-recurring; it will be visible as a credit line on the billing summary.

If that’s acceptable, reply to this thread with your confirmation and we’ll push the amendment. I’ve attached a short one-page terms PDF showing the extension window and credit application. If legal requires an addendum, we can route a DocuSign.

Best,
